art_direction: 成年庵歌姬穿红白层叠长衣，安静站在秋日庭院里，双手捧着一片枫叶。
composition_variation: Create a graceful watercolor anime portrait of adult Utahime Iori in an autumn courtyard. Preserve her long dark hair, tied white ribbon, calm brown eyes, and familiar pale facial scar as a healed character feature. Dress her in a fully covering white long-sleeve top and long deep red pleated skirt. She gently holds a single maple leaf at waist height with relaxed fingers. Use vermilion foliage, muted moss stones, pale gold air, soft paper grain, and a spacious quiet ivory sky. Design for native 1024x1536 portrait format: important forms inside x158..866, faces inside x240..784. Leave the upper 28 percent quiet for the lock-screen clock. Use an original composition, no copied frames or promotional layout, text, logos, UI, weapons, fighting, extra characters, or distorted anatomy.
